name: Nested Relation Semantics Governance Registry
purpose: Govern nested ⇔R expressions so they remain simultaneous recursive aspect-bindings rather than collapsing into sequential composition, associativity, transitivity, or ordinary logical biconditional structure.

core_definition.nested_expression_rule: Nested ⇔R structures must be interpreted as co-present aspect relations within one indivisible process whole, not as ordered chains of operations.

governed_expression_forms.allowed_reading: A, B, and C participate as simultaneous aspects of one restricted whole-relation.
governed_expression_forms.forbidden_reading: A leads to B, then B leads to C.

governed_expression_forms.allowed_reading: Bracketed notation marks analytical focus only.
governed_expression_forms.forbidden_reading: The bracketed expression becomes a separate primitive object.

governed_expression_forms.allowed_reading: Nested notation marks an aspect cluster under review.
governed_expression_forms.forbidden_reading: The inner relation is ontologically prior to the whole.

semantic_constraints.simultaneity_rule: All governed ⇔R participants are interpreted as co-present aspects unless explicitly projected into a sequential domain.
semantic_constraints.anti_flattening_rule: Nested ⇔R expressions may not be flattened into ordinary equivalence chains.
semantic_constraints.non_associativity_rule: (A ⇔R B) ⇔R C is not automatically equivalent to A ⇔R (B ⇔R C).
semantic_constraints.non_transitivity_rule: A ⇔R B and B ⇔R C do not automatically imply A ⇔R C.
semantic_constraints.non_hierarchy_rule: Nested structure does not imply ontological hierarchy.
semantic_constraints.non_substitution_rule: A ⇔R B does not license unrestricted substitution of A for B.
semantic_constraints.projection_exception_rule: Sequential, equal, compositional, or biconditional readings are permitted only as explicitly declared projection reductions with loss accounting.

allowed_uses: Reviewing nested ⇔R expressions without promoting them to theorem status.
Marking analytical aspect clusters inside indivisible relations.
Preventing nested expressions from becoming ordinary operator chains.
Preparing projection-derived equality, implication, composition, and biconditional registries.
forbidden_uses: Treating bracketed relations as independent primitives.
Using nested ⇔R to prove physical unification.
Using nested ⇔R to replace standard logic or arithmetic.
